name: Trackabi
description_en:
Trackabi combines time tracking, employee activity monitoring, leave planning and project billing records. Web, desktop and mobile routes serve different purposes: a manual/browser timer is distinct from desktop activity collection or mobile GPS routes.

It can turn time entries into reports and invoices, but activity scores and screenshots are observations rather than proof of output quality. Configure collection and review boundaries before enabling a team workflow.
description_zh:
Trackabi 结合工时记录、员工活动监测、休假规划及项目计费记录。网页、桌面及移动端用途不同：手动/浏览器计时与桌面活动采集、移动 GPS 路线不同。

它可把工时转成报表和发票，但活动评分及截图是观察记录，不能证明产出质量。启用团队流程前应配置采集与审核边界。

core_features.explanation_zh: 手动或计时器记录可生成报表、发票并跟踪客户付款。

core_features.explanation_en: Desktop activity/screenshots and mobile GPS routes are separate documented functions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 桌面活动/截图及移动 GPS 路线属于不同的文档功能。

en: Create the client/project context, establish the timer or manual-entry method and compare submitted time with the task estimate before preparing an invoice. The vendor documents PDF/Excel reports and payment tracking. A tracked payment status is not evidence that Trackabi itself processes a customer’s funds.

sections.title_en: Example: reconcile a project time report
sections.title_zh: 示例：核对项目工时报表
sections.en:
Create the client/project context, establish the timer or manual-entry method and compare submitted time with the task estimate before preparing an invoice. The vendor documents PDF/Excel reports and payment tracking. A tracked payment status is not evidence that Trackabi itself processes a customer’s funds.

Test a forgotten timer, idle interval and corrected entry so that an invoice does not blindly inherit an activity log. Desktop monitoring and GPS require their respective collection route; none was installed or tested here.
sections.zh:
建立客户/项目背景，确定计时器或手动填报方式，开票前将提交工时与任务估算比较。厂商说明可导出 PDF/Excel 报表并跟踪付款，但付款状态记录不证明 Trackabi 自身处理客户资金。

应测试忘关计时器、空闲区间及修正记录，避免发票机械继承活动日志。桌面监测和 GPS 需要各自采集渠道，本次均未安装或测试。

sections.en:
The pricing page lists Starter at $0 for five users. In the displayed annual, five-user state Growth showed $3.20/user/month, $16 for five users/month and $192 annually; Scale showed $4/user/month, $20 for five users/month and $240 annually. These are annual-billing equivalents, not verified month-to-month checkout prices. Enterprise requires a quote. Currency code was not explicit in the captured table, so no normalized currency is assumed.

Growth/Scale advertise a 30-day no-card trial. Applicable taxes can be added at checkout, and multiple independent company accounts each need their own membership plan. Monitoring retention, screenshot frequency, storage and API entitlements vary by plan; the flattened table was not reliable enough to assign every row to a tier.
sections.zh:
价格页列 Starter 免费且含五位用户。已显示的年度计费、五用户状态下，Growth 为每用户每月 $3.20，五用户每月 $16、每年 $192；Scale 为每用户每月 $4，五用户每月 $20、每年 $240。这是年度计费折算，不是已核实的逐月结账价。Enterprise 需报价；截取表格未明确币种代码，不推定标准币种。

Growth/Scale 宣传无需信用卡的 30 天试用，结账可能附加适用税费，多家独立公司账户各需自己的会员方案。监测保留、截图频率、存储和 API 权限依套餐而异，扁平化表格不足以将每行可靠映射到层级。

sections.title_en: Agree collection and access before rollout
sections.title_zh: 推广前明确采集及访问
sections.en:
A project team needing time, leave and billing records can evaluate the combined workflow. Choose user roles, explain what activity/location data is collected and limit report access to the intended reviewers. A low activity score should prompt contextual review rather than an automatic judgment about an employee.

No payroll correctness, leave approval, GPS accuracy, screenshot redaction, retention deletion, licence grant or recovery was verified. The official site’s product tour and deeper tier entitlements remain follow-up documentation tasks; browser access resolved the original HTML-shell blocker.
sections.zh:
同时需要工时、休假及计费记录的项目团队可评估此流程。应选择用户角色，说明采集哪些活动/位置数据，并把报表访问限定于预期审核人。活动评分偏低应引发结合背景的审核，不应自动判断员工。

未核实工资计算正确性、休假审批、GPS 精度、截图遮盖、保留删除、许可授权或恢复。产品导览及更细套餐权限仍需后续文档核对；浏览器访问已解决原 HTML 空壳阻塞。

research_gaps.en: Flattened pricing table prevents reliable tier-by-tier retention mapping; no installed monitoring, payroll or invoice test.
research_gaps.zh: 扁平价格表无法可靠映射逐层保留规则，未安装监测或测试工资/发票。
